newsitem.title: GERMANY: 1,000 UPS German staff protest at part-time.
newsitem.headline: 1,000 UPS German staff protest at part-time.

text.p: About 1,000 of the 14,000 United Parcel Service of America staff in Germany took part in worldwide protest rallies today Thursday, union officials said.
The largest protest in Germany was at the Mainz Gustavsburg centre where 250 workers demonstrated, the OeTV transport union said.
The rallies were part of a worldwide day of action called by the International Federation of Transport Workers (ITF) for improved employment condition with the global parcels company.

"At UPS full-time jobs are being changed in part-time jobs worldwide and contracts are increasingly being given to sub-contractors or the so-called self-employed," an OeTV statement said. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
